rdfs:label: Quotation
rdfs:comment: A qualified PROV Derivation in which the derived entity repeats (some or all of) the source entity's content, e.g. an excerpt or citation.
notes: Subclass of `urn:solid:Derivation`. Use when the new entity contains content directly lifted from another (excerpts, citations, screenshots). The quoting entity links to this node via `prov:qualifiedQuotation` (and may also assert `urn:solid:wasQuotedFrom` the source); the node's `prov:entity` is the quoted source. Distinct from `urn:solid:Revision` (substantive change to the same identity) and `urn:solid:PrimarySource` (first-hand origin).

history.note: Fixed example (prov:entity is the quoted source); comment/seeAlso now reference wasQuotedFrom.
